items.title: 3 hospitalized and suspect in custody after shooting at Des Moines post office, police say
items.brief: Three people were hospitalized and a suspect is in custody after a shooting at a post office Thursday morning near downtown Des Moines, Iowa, police said.

items.title: An American man with shifting identities and grandiose movie plans is convicted of murdering his girlfriend and child in Rome
items.brief: “My name is Rexal Ford,” the man born under the name Charles Francis Kaufmann told an Italian courtroom, in English, at the start of his double-murder trial in February.

items.title: Thicker bacon and ditching breakfast. Wendy’s hopes a menu shakeup can revive sales
items.brief: Wendy’s reported its seventh consecutive quarter of declining sales, prompting the company to reveal a turnaround plan while rejecting a massive takeover offer.

items.title: The Great Pacific Garbage Patch may now have so much plastic, it’s changing the color of the ocean
items.brief: Far out in the Pacific Ocean, between Hawaii and California, a wide patch of water has been changing color over the past two decades, becoming significantly bluer and greener.

items.title: Water rescues, evacuations underway as ‘catastrophic flood event’ hits North Georgia and southern Tennessee
items.brief: Homes and businesses are flooded, and water rescues and evacuations are in progress, as historic flooding impacts North Georgia and southern Tennessee.

items.title: Stocks plunge as midterm results send AI trade into a tailspin
